Ingrid: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on engineering process (release cadence, oncall, quality bars, SLAs). Posting the decisions and short answers.

Lee: Thanks! Can you reconfirm the cadence?

Ingrid: Sure: major release train every 2 weeks (Tue 09:00 PT), minor infra patches weekly (Thu), hotfixes ad-hoc via emergency playbook. Feature rollouts should use canaries and flags.

Matt: Freeze window?

Ingrid: 48h freeze before deploy for runtime/model-serving changes. Non-critical UI can be feature-flagged post-merge.

Sofia: Oncall: 2-week rotations, primary + secondary. Escalation: primary -> secondary -> oncall manager (20m) -> SRE lead. Targets: ack <10m, mitigation/rollback attempt <30m. Notify CS within 1h if hosted SLA affected.

Lee: Are these the default ack windows for Dedicated customers too?

Sofia: Default internal SLO is 10m. Enterprise SLAs for Dedicated can have contract-specific ack times in the SOW.

Emily: Canary windows and rollback thresholds?

Priya: Starting defaults: 5% for 1h, 25% for 6h, then 100% if green. Monitor quality evals, token-error, user error-rate, latency p95/p99. Auto-rollback triggers include quality drop >5% on labeled evals, user error rate >2x baseline, p99 latency +40% or p95 +200ms over baseline. ML will tune per-model.

Lee: Where are the playbooks?

devbot: Release playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-cadence
Canary policy: https://redwood.internal/platform/canary-policy
Incident runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/incident-response

Matt: Sales asks about SLA credits for hosted API downtime.

Ingrid: Public-facing SLA summary exists (99.9% monthly uptime). Credits pro-rata after incident classification. Dedicated/private terms in SOW. Internal sales doc: https://redwood.internal/sla-summary

Emily: Who owns evals and prompt sets?

Priya: Shared: Research owns harness and metrics, Product owns prompt sets & acceptance, Eng+SRE own rollout automation. We'll add a RACI to the playbook.

Lee: Can oncall rollback without PM approval?

Ingrid: Yes. Oncall may rollback for incidents meeting severity thresholds. Notify PMs but do not wait for approval.

Ingrid: We'll host a 45-min office hours next Wed 4pm PT to walk the playbook. Calendar: https://calendar.internal/event/eng-playbook-qa. Priya will update the playbook with canary numbers by EOD Friday.

Matt: Great, thanks everyone.

Emily: Will review and open follow-ups on the doc. :thumbsup:
